SUMMARY

raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS
Capital markets expertise • Investment Banking • Change management strategies • Strong communication skills • Business analysis methodologies • Agile project delivery
Reference data oversight • Requirement elicitation techniques • Process improvement initiatives • Stakeholder Management • Data governance practices • Data validation
APPLICATIONS & PLATFORMS
Collibra Enterprise Catalog • Snowflake/Data Mesh • ADO/JIRA • SQL - Beginner • Power BI /Tableau - intermediate • Vermilion
raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
07/2024 - Current
Lead Business Analyst
Neurealm (Client: Northern Trust)- Chennai, India
Improved clarity and accuracy by identifying reliable sources for reference
data within enterprise data domain.
Facilitated Collibra implementation of reference data code sets, validating
processes from development through production.
Developed efficient procedures enabling users to implement changes
seamlessly.
Created comprehensive notification change documents to keep users
informed on updates.
Engaged in data taxonomy projects, defining subdomains and business terms
for diverse asset classes in Collibra.
Analyzed both internal and external reference data to ensure adherence to
regulatory requirements.
12/2015 - 01/2024
• Crafted user stories in ADO, maintaining oversight until successful
implementation.
Reference data is a Risk control Enhancement project which focuses on
introducing new data sets to reduce data related risk in Capital Market
Operations.
Contributed to product backlog grooming sessions, effectively prioritizing tasks
for streamlined execution.
Assistant Manager Lead
BNP Paribas Securities Services - Chennai, TN
BA RESPONSIBILITIES:
Middle office - Change Management responsibilities:
Coordinating client onboarding projects with requirement gathering, BRD and
FRD.
Preparation of test cases and carry down end to end testing (Smoke, regression
and UAT) according to the need.
Involved in Dakar re-engineering project – Decommission of ODW with FTE
realization.
Involved in Global PME migration project from Legacy release structure.
Coordinating with the Development team to implement and test the new
client requirement.
Working on post implementation requirements from client – Configuration
changes, involvement in critical incidents, fixing bugs and providing client with
RCA.
OPERATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES
Middle office - Client Reporting responsibilities:
High level monthly report prepared for multiple client / portfolios ABOR
reporting.
Month end positions are reconciled against transaction to ensure the
consistency of report.
Issues are highlighted with Ops team if month end reconciliation fails due to
invalid trade posted, booked trade with insufficient information, incorrect
cancel/rebook, etc.
Identifying the solution to the STP fails by doing RCA for the failure.
Preparation of Vermilion reporting – Detailed reporting detailing cash balances,
income details, withdrawals etc.
Middle office - Treasury Cash Management:
Involved in FX repatriation through non-preferred ccy to preferred ccy in order
maintain cash balances in client account.
All non-trade related activities like Derivatives, Income (Dividend, coupons),
Corporate Actions are FXed.
Ensure to provide Cash forecast of all accounts to the client at start of the day
by which client is aware of the available cash.
Involved in preparation of Investment balances to the client post repatriating
FX to preferred ccy.
06/2014 - 12/2015
RECENT PROJECTS
